user.title: Sign in to MyTOYOTA Israel
user.description: Use the same phone number and Israeli ID you use in the MyTOYOTA app. A one-time code will be sent by SMS.

data_description.personal_id: Your teudat zehut, as registered with Union Motors

code.title: Enter the code
code.description: Enter the code sent to {phone}. It expires after about a minute.

telematics.title: Live vehicle data
telematics.description:
Battery level, charging state and location come from the Ituran unit in {cars}, and reading them means registering Home Assistant with Ituran using a second SMS code.

Only one device can hold that registration at a time. Turning this on signs the MyTOYOTA app out of live vehicle data, and signing back in on the app takes it away from Home Assistant again.

Leave it off to keep the app working: odometer, servicing dates and vehicle specs do not need it.

activate.title: Registration failed
activate.description: Ituran did not send a code for {car}. Continue to try again.

activate_code.title: Confirm with Ituran
activate_code.description: Ituran has sent a code for {car}. This is a different code from the one you used to sign in.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved token for {phone} is no longer accepted. Signing in again will send a new SMS code.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Toyota server. Try again shortly.
error.no_account_match: No account matches that phone number and ID.
error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. It may have expired.
error.ituran_failed: Ituran did not complete the registration. Try again, or continue without live vehicle data.

abort.already_configured: This Toyota account is already set up.

init.title: Polling
init.description: How often to ask Toyota for new data. Every request wakes the telematics unit in the car, so prefer longer intervals unless you need the detail.
